name: Succubu ☆ Soon!
source:
The protagonist's father makes a deal with a devil. Shortly thereafter, a succubus visits the hero's home. She was there to fulfill his father's contract. However, she falls in love with our hero at first sight, and decides to live with him and his stepsister instead. Soon the succubus' mother comes knocking, and even she wants to move in on the action! Of course, being succubae, they need to get laid once in a while to keep going--might as well give them what they want!

[From White Masq]
translation:
主人公的父亲与恶魔做了一笔交易。不久之后，一位梦魔造访了主人公的家。她本是来履行父亲的契约的。然而，她对主人公一见钟情，决定留下来与他和他的义妹同居。很快，梦魔的母亲也找上门来，甚至连她也想加入！当然，作为梦魔，她们需要不时与人交合才能维持生存——那就满足她们吧！

[来自White Masq]
